items.title: The forth Shapsug congress
items.notes: 4th Congress of the Black Sea Shapsugs. August 26-29, 1924, Tuapse. Adopted a resolution on the formation of the Shapsug National Region of the Black Sea District.

items.title: Katao Hasan and Shhalakhua Fatimat
items.notes: Wedding in the village of Maly Kichmay. Shhalakhua Fatimat is dancing withe eldest Katao Hasan as she was chosen as the most beautiful girl of the day in a usual ritual happenes in every dance.

items.notes: The picture has been taken in Hakurinahabl village, but there are two stories whether it is in Adygea 1910 or in Turkey 1918

items.title: Chesebi Shumaf Beslanovich
items.notes: He was an officer from 1879 and then he became the head of Asokolai town, was killed by the Bolshoviks in 1918 with other men.

items.title: Dolmen in Chygudj
items.notes: Khadzhokh or Chigiwij Dolmen [Chygyuj] in the northern outskirts of the Kamennomost hamlet, Maikop District, Adigea. It is thought that the dolmen received its name from its location near a holy grove and a sacred tree

items.title: Knives
items.notes: From top to bottom. Three boxwood knives (the top two with solid pommels) and a bone knife—tools for weaving on boards. From the collection of the Lazarevskoye Ethnographic Museum

items.title: Syrian president Ahmad Nami
items.notes: Ahmad Nami is with his government members. Ahmad Ibrahim Fakhri Nami (Damat Ahmet Nami). Married to Aysha, the daughter of Ottoman Sultan Abdul Hamid II. He was a prominent political figure who served as the second President of Syria and its fifth Prime Minister.
